mentions.h: It's a AAA 6 stage hat trick!
mentions.note: stage 2, took Telford from 31st to 2nd and broke Chris Thompson's course record by nearly half a minute

mentions.h: The AAA 5k Road Race at Horwich

photos.c: Above: The AAA 5k Road Race was again held in Horwich. It was only the second time the Championship has been held and the Bels have medalled on each occasion – silver in 2005 and now gold in 2006. Individual AAA Champion was Chris Davies of Telford (in the red and yellow), second was Peter Riley of Leigh (white vest with green diagonal) and third was our own Mark Miles (177). Simon Jones (not pictured) and Richard Ward (181) made up the Belgrave team. The Open race was won by Birchfield, running three Africans, but they were not eligible for the AAA race.
